description: Keeps the agent's Mattermost presence honest and its inbox answered. On a new prompt the bot shows as 🛠 working; when the turn ends it goes back to 💤 idle. Before a turn may end, the bus's pending count is checked and the stop is blocked while a mention or DM is still waiting — the messages themselves are delivered through the MCP server. Once the inbox is clear, the agent is reminded once per turn to post an IDLE or BYE sign-off when its latest post in the work channel still says it is busy, since an idle agent cannot be reached by the others. In a project channel the agent then keeps listening on the bus for MM_LISTEN_SEC (default 90 min; the coordinator MM_LISTEN_COORD_SEC, default 2 h) before going idle: the agent starts a background listener that waits without the model and wakes it when a message arrives, and the next prompt stops it. Each block shows the developer a one-line banner saying why the turn goes on — while listening with the window end. After the conversation is compacted, the agent gets its own latest sign-offs from the bus back, so the handoff state survives. The hooks and the listener hold no bot token: they ask this session's MCP server over a local API (127.0.0.1, per-session key) and do nothing when it is not running or has no bus session; in a corral session that server runs on the host and the sandbox holds no token at all. Posts no prompt or file content.
